about: Neighbour footprints within 200 m of the facility point, with heights (simplified) and their source; rings in metres relative to the facility point (x east, y north, the tool’s local frame). Footprints: Public Safety Canada, Canada Structures (12 Sep 2025; Open Government Licence - Canada; doi:10.82126/z1bc-zd72); heights: City of Vancouver LiDAR 2022 where the outline is mostly building cells, else Canada Structures. No height on record = null (draw flat, never guess)., project decision.
